criteria.observation: Red bound firecracker bundle, ivory pearl and cyan water bolt remain distinct at 120 and 160 px; all are recognizable at 64 px.
Bomb bands wrap three cylinders, one fuse joins the top cap; the pearl trail joins behind the round head; three interior water bands cross a connected bolt.
Closed dark contours and clean transparent margins; selected bolt r02 removes the protruding wave caps from r01.
Upper-left cream accents, warm red/gold bomb, ivory/lavender pearl and teal/cyan water; cream zigzag is visible inside the water bolt at native scale.
One centered projectile per canvas. Pearl and bolt lead right with a tapering left tail; both have visually balanced upper/lower contours around a horizontal axis.
Shared brown contour, chunky shapes and restrained cel shading; no character parts, text or unrelated decoration.

All three exports are 256x256 with generated alpha; full scans find zero nontransparent edge pixels, minimum 25 px clear margins, and near-opaque interiors. Slicer reports have zero clipping/source-edge touch.

rejected.shot_voirong_bolt_v01.r01: Protruding upper/lower wave caps made the outer contour asymmetric. Retained raw, prompt and Bolt report; replaced by r02.

limits: Visual shape balance rather than exact reflected-pixel equality. Flat RGB regions and native game integration were not proved; generated near-opaque alpha was preserved. Separate user approval of these revisions has not been collected.
